title: 'Daily Show' has a blunt reaction to the outcome of Trump's AI summit
excerpt: "I'm sure we could trust these guys."
content_html:
"I'm sure we could trust these guys."

 

By

Sam Haysom

Sam Haysom

Sam Haysom is the General Assignment Editor, UK, for Mashable. He covers entertainment and online culture, and writes horror fiction in his spare time.

on October 1, 2026

Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on Flipboard

Trump held a summit recently with tech leaders on AI, and the two main outcomes seemed to be 1. A signed document where the leaders vaguely agreed to police themselves internally, and 2. Yet another push by Trump to rename artificial intelligence to "super intelligence".

So is the signed document legally binding in any way? In the Daily Show clip above, host Jordan Klepper plays a clip of Trump shrugging off the question, saying it's "morally binding".

"Morally binding, sure! We don't need laws! I'm sure we could trust these guys." responds Klepper. "You know I'm not saying this self-policing document they signed is bullshit that they barely bothered to read, but I will say they did misspell 'United States'."
